# Circle

> Circle is an iOS app for saving songs, films, books, links, and places, making thoughtful collections, and discovering through people whose taste you trust.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-13.

## Official facts

- Official website: https://sruper.com/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744259628
- Platform: iOS
- Company: Sruper Inc.
- Official account: @circle
- People can save songs, films, books, links, and places.
- A collection can contain up to 30 things.

## Canonical terminology

- **Thing**: A saved song, film, book, link, place, photo, note, or other media object.
- **Save**: The action for saving a thing or collection in Circle.
- **Collection**: A group of up to 30 things chosen around a place, trip, mood, idea, or person.
- **Your circle**: The people you follow in Circle.
